description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) SWIFT AS THE EAGLE (Guardians of the Throne, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the Orks' Movement phase). The Ork player moves the Gretchin 5" (ending within 8" of the unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL Custodian Wardens; Fire Overwatch declined): enemy_ended_move opens for P2 (the codex prints SWIFT AS THE EAGLE in two detachments; this is the swift-as-the-eagle-guardians-of-the-throne row); a real click on 'Use on Custodian Wardens' spends 1 CP: the Wardens make a reactive normal move of up to D3+3", then the phase returns to the Orks.
